allow: Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command 'Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }')
Bash(awk '/^COMMIT/{if\(c!=""&&t>0\)printf "%6d  %s\\n",t,c; c=$0; t=0; next} NF==3 && $1!="-" {t+=$1} END{if\(c!=""\)printf "%6d  %s\\n",t,c}')
PowerShell(git status --short | Select-Object -First 30; "--- tracked-file status count ---"; \(git status --porcelain | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)
PowerShell("--- status ---"; git status --short; "--- \(clean if blank\) ---"; "--- branch ---"; git status -sb | Select-Object -First 1)

PowerShell(foreach \($p in @\("nas_data_tier/.env","infra/terraform/terraform.tfvars"\)\) { $live = git hash-object $p; $saved = git rev-parse "stash@{0}^3:$p"; $ok = if \($live -eq $saved\) { "OK match" } else { "MISMATCH" }; "$ok  $p"; "   tracked? " + $\(if \(git ls-files --error-unmatch $p 2>$null\) { "YES - PROBLEM" } else { "no \(ignored, correct\)" }\) }; "--- NOTICE ---"; if \(Test-Path NOTICE\) { "PRESENT, tracked: " + [bool]\(git ls-files NOTICE\) })

PowerShell("--- package.json deps now ---"; \(Get-Content package.json | Select-String -Pattern 'react|react-dom|react-router' -SimpleMatch\); "--- installed on disk ---"; foreach \($m in @\("react","react-router","react-router-dom"\)\) { $pj = "node_modules\\$m\\package.json"; if \(Test-Path $pj\) { "$m = " + \(Get-Content $pj -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\).version } else { "$m = NOT INSTALLED" } })
